value.title: Major professional sports leagues in the United States and Canada
value.extract: Major professional sports leagues in the United States and Canada, which compete in baseball, basketball, football, ice hockey, and soccer, include Major League Baseball (MLB), the National Basketball Association (NBA), the National Football League (NFL), the National Hockey League (NHL), and Major League Soccer (MLS). The NFL only competes in the United States, with the prominent football league in Canada being the Canadian Football League (CFL).
